paper.title: Towards Costless Model Selection in Contextual Bandits: A Bias-Variance Perspective

settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic contextual bandits with model selection over nested reward model classes
unmapped: Model selection over M nested model classes F_1..F_M with complexities d_i; at least one class is realizable (B_i = 0), others may be misspecified
The learner knows the estimation rates xi_i(n,zeta) = C_1 (d_i ln(nM/zeta)/n)^rho (known C_1, rho, class complexities d_i)
Access to estimation, policy-evaluation and misspecification-test oracles
settings.definition_quote: At every time-step $t \in [T]$, nature samples a context $x_t\in\Xscript$ and reward vector $\smash{r_t \in [0,1]^K}$ from the fixed but unknown distribution $D$. Upon observing context $x_t$, the learner chooses an arm $a_t$ and receives a reward $r_t(a_t)$.

algorithms.name: Mod-IGW (Model selection with Inverse Gap Weighting)

bound.regime: for any i <= j in [M'] such that class F_j is not labelled misspecified as of round T

symbols.omega: unknown constant >1 in Assumptions 2-3 (gradual complexity growth / diminishing returns)
symbols.rho: exponent of the estimation rate xi_i, in (0,1]
symbols.d_im1: complexity of class F_{i-1} (0 for i=1)
symbols.beta_im1: policy-class bias of class i-1, R(pi*)-R(pi*_{i-1}) (1 for i=1)
symbols.beta_j: policy-class bias of class j, R(pi*)-R(pi*_j)

conditions: Assumption 2: gradually increasing class complexity with constant omega
Assumption 3: diminishing policy improvement Delta_i non-increasing
Oracle Assumptions 1-4 hold (estimation oracle with rate xi_i, policy value estimation, policy evaluation, misspecification test)

source.label: thm:main-theorem
source.quote: Suppose \Cref{ass:gradual,ass:realizability,ass:opt-value-jump} hold and the oracle subroutines perform as stated in ... With probability at least $1 - \delta$: for any $i,j\in[M']$ such that $i\leq j$ and $\allF_j$ not yet labelled as misspecified as of round $T$, $\CVBandit$ attains the following regret guarantee: \CReg_T \leq \ordOt( (\omega^2K^{1/\rho})\frac{\alld_{i-1}}{\beta_{i-1}^{2/\rho}} + \beta_jT + (\frac{\alld_j}{\alld_i})^{\rho/2}\sqrt{K\alld_j^{\rho} T^{2-\rho}} ) Here $\ordOt$ hides terms logarithmic in $T, M, 1/\delta, \alld_{i^*}$. Further, $\allF_j$ is not determined to be misspecified for at least $\Omega(\alld_j/B_j^{1/\rho})$ rounds.

results.notes: CReg_T = sum_t Reg_{f*}(p_t), regret of exploration policies against pi*, bounded with probability 1-delta. Theorem also states F_j not flagged misspecified for at least Omega(d_j/B_j^{1/rho}) rounds (not recorded as a separate result). Special cases discussed in text: i=j=i* gives O~(sqrt(K d_{i*} T)) for rho=1; i=1, j=i* gives O~(sqrt(d_{i*}/d_1) sqrt(K T d_{i*})). Theorem number not printed in source.
